NDT Training and Certification in Point Lisas — Trinidad and Tobago

Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT and ISO 9712 aligned NDT training in Point Lisas: Level I, Level II and Level III programmes across ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and visual testing, plus API 510, API 570 and API 653 inspector preparation. Courses are authored and supervised by ASNT NDT Level III professionals.

The Point Lisas inspection market

Point Lisas Industrial Estate, on Trinidad's west coast near Couva, is the Caribbean's largest petrochemical and LNG-adjacent industrial complex — Atlantic LNG's liquefaction trains, the National Gas Company (NGC) pipeline network, Methanol Holdings Trinidad Limited's methanol/ammonia plants, and Yara Trinidad's ammonia production. Continuous ammonia-reactor and pipeline turnarounds drive steady multi-method NDT demand distinct from Trinidad's wider upstream sector.

Certifications most in demand in Point Lisas

Primary: ASNT. Secondary: ISO 9712. Also frequently requested: PCN.

Recommended certification pathway

Atlantic LNG, NGC and the Point Lisas ammonia/methanol plants apply ASNT SNT-TC-1A as the baseline personnel-qualification standard, with ISO 9712 recognised for European-affiliated EPC turnaround contractors. PCN appears on UK-led plant-integrity packages.

Delivery formats

  • Classroom cohorts with supervised practical hours logged to SNT-TC-1A requirements.
  • On-site corporate training at your facility using your equipment and specimens.
  • Blended online theory through Atlantis LMS with in-person practical assessment.
